name: Anthracite Hannam
description: A specialty cafe with a vintage vibe, converted from an old factory. High ceilings and exposed concrete define the space, and single-origin beans are roasted in house. Spacious seating and a quiet atmosphere make it great for working alone or reading.

name: Blue Bottle Samcheong
description: Blue Bottle's flagship store near Bukchon Hanok Village. The interior keeps the hanok's traditional exterior while blending in a modern feel. Drip coffee and lattes are the signature menu items, and branded merchandise is available.

name: Onion Seongsu
description: A landmark Seongsu-dong bakery cafe converted from an old military uniform factory. Croissants and salt bread are the signature items, drawing long lines on weekends. The retro charm of the 1930s building also makes it a popular photo spot.

name: Terarosa Gangnam
description: The Gangnam branch of a specialty coffee brand from Gangneung. An open roastery inside the store fills the air with the scent of roasting beans. Spacious seating and reliable wifi make it a popular spot for meetings.

name: Cafe Knotted Hongdae
description: A Hongdae dessert cafe that earned nationwide fame for its cream donuts. Cute bear-shaped cupcakes and seasonal specials frequently go viral on social media. The bright, cheerful interior is especially popular with younger visitors.

name: Gongmyung Cafe Insadong
description: A traditional hanok teahouse tucked inside an Insadong alley. Try traditional drinks like ssanghwa tea, citron tea, and jujube tea alongside yakgwa and other Korean sweets. Its quiet, serene atmosphere makes it a popular Korean culture experience spot for foreign visitors.
